title: From Traditional Farming to AI-Enabled Mushroom Production
story: Green Harvest Mushrooms Ltd partnered with the BRIDGE-AI Kenya project to modernize its mushroom production process through AI and smart farming technologies. The team participated in training workshops on mushroom cultivation, environmental monitoring, and IoT sensor deployment. By implementing automated monitoring of temperature and humidity, the company improved consistency during incubation and reduced crop losses caused by environmental fluctuations. Staff also adopted digital record-keeping and data-driven decision-making to optimize production schedules. Within the first production cycle, the farm reported healthier mushroom growth, improved operational efficiency, and increased confidence in adopting innovative agricultural technologies. Today, Green Harvest Mushrooms Ltd serves as a demonstration site, showcasing how AI-powered farming can enhance productivity while promoting sustainable agriculture and creating new opportunities for local communities.
